title: Chicken Pasta Salad with Corn, Black Beans and Lime
changes_from_base: Griddled chicken, sweetcorn, black beans and peppers go in, and a tangy horseradish-mayonnaise dressing with lime replaces the oil-and-vinegar dressing.
summary: A hearty picnic pasta salad with griddled chicken, sweetcorn, black beans and peppers in a tangy horseradish, lime and cider-vinegar mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Griddle the chicken
steps.text: Rub the chicken with oil, salt and pepper and cook on a hot griddle 5-6 min a side until it reads 74 °C. Rest 5 min, then shred.

steps.title: Cook pasta and corn
steps.text: Boil the pasta in the salted water; add the frozen corn for the last minute. Drain, rinse cold and shake dry.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, horseradish, lime juice and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the pasta and corn with the chicken, beans, peppers, onion, jalapeño and coriander, then fold in the dressing. Chill 20 min before serving.

tips: Leftover roast or barbecued chicken works well.
Rinse the beans well so the dressing stays pale.
Add extra lime just before serving to wake it up.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
